purpose: Identify core/ files that remain legacy desktop support and must not be required by the headless Electron backend.

headless_requirements_policy.notes: Normal clone users install this file for Python Headless Web. Qt and desktop-only dependencies must never flow into the supported headless runtime.

legacy_core_files.notes: Desktop AppContext wires ModernMainWindow, ModeAwareModuleManager, ImageCrudController, and legacy desktop event semantics.
Desktop image-window save/classification controller. Headless save/output flows use WebSessionContext and headless result services.
Manages legacy middle-module mode visibility through AppContext callbacks.
Desktop autocomplete adapter over generated root dictionaries. Headless autocomplete uses kr_tag_loader and TagSearchIndex.
Formerly imported by the removed legacy_desktop/NAIA_cold_v4.py entrypoint for desktop Windows DLL loading. Not a headless backend startup dependency.
